wire-supplement.title: Members of spec-defined enumerations the 1.0 text does not list

notes: The 1.0 specification defines no JSON key and no URL path segment that contains 'esri' or 'arcgis'; jsonKeys and pathSegments are therefore empty. The '/arcgis/rest/services' URL root is a server-instance naming convention, not a specification requirement.
